description: Proposal contains two provenance entries with the same id ('approved_invoice'). Under v0.9.0a2 the pipeline enforces the spec-core §6.1 uniqueness requirement at step 2c (after JSON Schema validation and lone-surrogate rejection, before impact resolution, tool binding, evidence verification, and causal-taint evaluation). The proposal is rejected with PIC_DUPLICATE_ID. Comparison is exact per spec-core §7.2: implementations must not trim, case-fold, or Unicode-normalize IDs before comparing them.
